subject: Regional guardrails discovery — post-call recap & next steps (InsuranceAI)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@insuranceai.com>, procurements@insuranceai.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 14:10:00 -0000
Subject: Regional guardrails discovery — post-call recap & next steps (InsuranceAI)

Hi Lena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we’re aligned: 

Call highlights:
- You confirmed InsuranceAI requires US-only primary residency for customer PII, with cross-region backups limited to encrypted, access-controlled replicas for DR.
- Logging/audit retention: minimum 365 days for request/response metadata; full request payload retention varies by data classification (PII = not retained beyond processing unless explicitly opted).
- Procurement wants a standard MPA and a filled security questionnaire before legal signs off.

Actions (owner / target):
- Redwood: provide a short region-capabilities brief + filled security questionnaire (stated below) — STEPHANIE (EOD 1/18) [attachment: redwood-region-capabilities.pdf, security-questionnaire-filled.pdf]
- Redwood: send draft MPA for legal review — BEN (EOD 1/19) [attachment: draft-mpa.docx]
- InsuranceAI: confirm whether "PII" in your classification includes user-supplied documents (yes/no) and whether they need to be persistently stored.

Open technical questions we flagged for you to confirm so our ops teams can size the deployment: 
1) Cross-region failover window objective — are you OK with cold standby (minutes-to-hours) vs warm standby (seconds-to-minutes)?
2) If replicas are stored in EU for backup, do you require any additional encryption-at-rest keys or separate KMS control?
3) Which specific logs do you need exported to your SIEM (auth events, request metadata, full payloads)?

Next sync: propose 1/20 10:00 PT to walk procurement + security through the MPA highlights and the residency controls.

Thanks — attaching the brief and questionnaire.

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0118
https://redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@insuranceai.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 16:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Regional guardrails discovery — post-call recap & next steps (InsuranceAI)

Thanks — filing draft MPA to the thread and flagging a couple of operational notes for sizing: 

- For strict US-primary residency with encrypted cross-region backups we recommend a warm-standby in US East and cold replica in EU to minimize cross-border read access. That aligns with their stated priority (PII stays US).
- We should model retention as: request metadata 365d (default), request payloads for PII none by default (can opt-in per tenant), and token-level telemetry (anonymized) retained 90d.

I'll attach the MPA draft and a short ops matrix for the two standby options. Stephanie — can you confirm the exact phrasing InsuranceAI wants for the "no-persistent PII" commitment? I will incorporate before sending to legal.

Attaching: draft-mpa.docx, redwood-ops-matrix.xlsx

--
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@insuranceai.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@insuranceai.com, procurements@insuranceai.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jan 2028 01:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Regional guardrails discovery — post-call recap & next steps (InsuranceAI)

Thanks Stephanie and Ben — good summary. A couple of clarifications from our security lead (cc'd):

- PII scope: confirmed — customer-identifiable data includes name, DOB, SSN, and uploads that contain those fields. We do not want persistent storage of full document contents unless we explicitly grant an exception.
- Cross-region replica: acceptable as encrypted, but InsuranceAI requires separate KMS control for EU replicas (we prefer bring-your-own-key for EU). Please confirm if Redwood supports per-replica KMS key separation.
- Failover: procurement prefers warm standby with RTO <15 minutes for core inference endpoints. Is that achievable within the pricing tier discussed?
- Logs: we need auth events + request metadata forwarded to our Splunk instance; payloads should never be forwarded. Retention requirement: 365 days on the logs we receive.

Also — please include a short diagram of the backup path and the key control flow for our security team.

Lena
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product | InsuranceAI
lena.ortiz@insuranceai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@insuranceai.com>, security@insuranceai.com, procurements@insuranceai.com
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jan 2028 09:32:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Regional guardrails discovery — post-call recap & next steps (InsuranceAI)

Lena — great questions, thanks. Short answers and attachments to address each ask: 

1) PII scope & storage: we can commit to default no-persistent storage of PII (processing only) and offer an explicit opt-in toggle for longer retention if you sign the MPA addendum. See section 3.2 in draft-mpa.docx (attached).

2) KMS per-replica: yes — Redwood supports customer-managed keys per-region. For EU replica we can configure a separate KMS key (BYOK). We'll include a diagram showing the replication encryption envelope and key separation (attached in redwood-region-capabilities.pdf).

3) Failover / RTO: warm standby with targeted RTO <15 minutes is achievable using dedicated reserved capacity + warm pool. Ben's ops matrix (redwood-ops-matrix.xlsx) outlines the cost delta. I'll summarize here: warm standby ~ +18% monthly over baseline for the tier we discussed; exact number depends on throughput.

4) Logs: we will forward only auth events and request metadata to your Splunk endpoint; payloads will be excluded by default. Retention on our side for those forwarded logs is configurable — we can retain 365d and provide daily export snapshots if you need an immutable copy.

Attachments included: security-questionnaire-filled.pdf, redwood-region-capabilities.pdf, draft-mpa.docx

Next steps: 
- Ben to finalize cost estimate for warm standby (EOD 1/19).
- Stephanie to schedule 1/20 10:00 PT joint review with procurement & security.
- Lena to confirm whether InsuranceAI will require BYOK procurement now or after PO.

If helpful, I can also prepare a 1-page diagram for the key flow and send before the meeting.

Thanks — look forward to finalizing the MPA.

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
